scope: Prepare exactly three full-Train Classification CSVs; no Kaggle upload, no Test labels, no candidate selection by Test outputs.

data.test_use: features and ordered record IDs for inference only after trained-state freeze

c2b.structured: EXPANDED_FEATURES from the original ClassificationModel C2_B recipe
c2b.scaler: StandardScaler fit on C2_B numeric structured output
c2b.tfidf: Reuse A02 E79 fitted vectorizer after full vocabulary, parameters, train-document hash, row population, and IDF verification; do not fit TF-IDF

c1b_missing_fallback.route: exact C1_B HGB probability for stream-missing rows in POS_BAG_OFFSET and JOINTPOS

shared_components.position_block: POSITIONAL_TEXT_PILOT_V1 build_position_block; shared C2_B analyzer and IDF; only shared-vocabulary unigram entries; thirds floor(3*i/n); (1+ln(count))*IDF; one row-wise L2 normalization; real ordering; no shuffle

CGEOM_ALIGNED.model: exact CoefficientGeometryPredictor aligned arm at origin 79
CGEOM_ALIGNED.coefficient_map: same full-Train C2_B coefficient mapped by exact shared vocabulary token identity into A02 column order
CGEOM_ALIGNED.prediction: original Sparse25 baseline + mass-matched A02 residual memory correction; original clipping, threshold, and fallback

POS_BAG_OFFSET.model: C2_B logit as fixed offset plus real-position gamma only
POS_BAG_OFFSET.optimizer: L-BFGS-B, zero initialization, C=1, maxiter=2000, ftol=1e-12, gtol=1e-6, maxls=50; no retries

JOINTPOS.model: joint C2_B bag + real-position blocks LogisticRegression with original C2_B settings

output.id_order: official Test order, matching SampleSubmission exactly
